extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: light helicopter, approx. 9.4 x 2.1 x 2.9 m (L x W x H, fuselage incl. tail boom and skids), main rotor diameter 10.0 m, tail rotor diameter 1.44 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; main rotor (helicopter_main_rotor) is a separate object with origin on the rotor mast axis, spins around Z; tail rotor (helicopter_tail_rotor) is a separate object with origin on its hub, spins around X (mounted on the left side); skids stand on the ground; opaque tinted windows, no interior; neutral emblem, no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
